agent_explanation: Shrunk case is single body (e=1) bouncing off right arena boundary. Energy is conserved until step 137 then jumps at step 138 from ~1054 J to 1294 J (22% gain) when vx flips from +43.86 to -49.04 during boundary collision with 2 substeps. With e=1 the collision should be elastic (no gain), but semi-implicit Euler with positional correction / impulse adds spurious kinetic energy on high-speed impact, exceeding the 10%+5J energy_bound tolerance. Lowering restitution removes gain.
